title: VISUAL ADVERSARIAL EXAMPLES JAILBREAK ALIGNED LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Optimizing visual adversarial examples using derogatory sentences against specific races and evaluating the model's propensity to generate racial identity attacks using curated prompts, Perspective API, and the Detoxify classifier.

Optimizing visual adversarial examples using derogatory sentences against specific genders and measuring the generation of gender-based identity attacks via manual inspection and automated toxicity scoring.

Evaluating the jailbroken model's likelihood of generating derogatory content targeting specific religious groups (e.g., Jewish and Muslim communities) using manual inspection and the RealToxicityPrompts benchmark.

Assessing the generation of identity attacks against the LGBTQ+ community triggered by visual adversarial examples, evaluated via manual inspection of responses to identity attack prompts and automated toxicity classifiers.
Measuring the jailbroken model's propensity to generate harmful content and identity attacks targeting individuals with disabilities using manual evaluation and API-based toxicity scores.
